main_measure.name: t of the slope of 10-day excess return on forecast (non-overlapping grid, forecast > 0)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 (with weighted mean excess > 0); reject if t <= -2

decided_by: Only 81 grid cells have a forecast above 0, fewer than the plan's minimum of 100.
reading: The normal drift is each coin's mean 10-day return over all non-overlapping grid cells of all its windows; the regression pools all coins and windows; the plan's '<100 cells is inconclusive' is applied as the minimum count, giving 'not observable'.
